page: Microsoft Azure D48ps_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on 64-bit ARM (arm64) architecture. Managed under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance provides 48 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 192.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU to meet standard enterprise application demands.

Hardware integration for the D48ps_v7 excludes local storage drives, designating it as a diskless compute node. Persistent storage and root filesystem operations depend entirely on remote network storage, with native support for Azure Premium Storage. The instance does not feature integrated graphical processing units (0 GPUs) and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses upon deployment.

The 48-core ARM architecture offers high core density and compute efficiency for workloads compiled for arm64 execution. Because the instance lacks ephemeral local disks, persistent I/O throughput is defined by network-attached storage limits. The D48ps_v7 is designed for multi-threaded services, container orchestration nodes, backend application servers, and distributed enterprise workloads.
